About the Fellowship

MIT's Tayebati programme supports postdoctoral work involving artificial intelligence across disciplines. Applicants propose research within the programme's scope and must meet its specific immigration or citizenship eligibility conditions as well as academic requirements.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Interdisciplinary research
  • Computing

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 73,308–90,000/year plus benefits

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilitySpecified US citizenship or immigration categories
Further conditionsCitizenship/immigration eligibility restrictions apply; check US citizen, PR, DACA and OPT rules.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026, 23:59
LocationUnited States

About Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

MIT conducts research across science, engineering and other fields. Its Schwarzman College of Computing hosts the Tayebati postdoctoral programme, supporting interdisciplinary work involving artificial intelligence.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://computing.mit.edu/research/postdoctoral-fellows-programs/tayebati-postdoctoral-fellowship-program/

Source: computing.mit.edu - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 November 2026, 23:59 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Review the eligibility criteria carefully; applications outside the stated scope are usually rejected at the first screening stage.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 November 2026, 23:59. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
